sentences.en: From NPR, this is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是NPR，欢迎收听《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: When crisis hits, people go into survival mode.
sentences.zh: 当危机来袭，人们会进入生存模式。

sentences.en: Some go further, putting self-interest and self-preservation over the well-being of others.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至走得更远，将个人利益和自我保护置于他人的福祉之上。

sentences.en: We're seeing this with the COVID-19 pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们在新冠疫情期间就看到了这一点。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, I'm not going to let it stop me from partying.
sentences.zh: 说到底，我不会让它阻止我参加派对。

sentences.en: We've been waiting for Miami spring break for a while.
sentences.zh: 我们期待迈阿密的春假已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: Some people have refused to wear masks in stores.
sentences.zh: 有些人拒绝在商店里戴口罩。

sentences.en: It's become an all-too-familiar scene across the country.
sentences.zh: 这在全国各地已成为司空见惯的场景。

sentences.en: People getting physical over wearing masks inside stores.
sentences.zh: 人们因为在商店里戴口罩的问题而大打出手。
这是强制要求的，但遗憾的是……

sentences.en: And there are even those who have bought up medical equipment to sell at a profit.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有人囤积医疗设备以高价转卖。

sentences.en: The agents were investigating 43-year-old Baruch Feldman
sentences.zh: 特工们正在调查43岁的巴鲁克·费尔德曼，

sentences.en: for allegedly hoarding medical supplies, including masks and gowns, and selling them...
sentences.zh: 他涉嫌囤积包括口罩和防护服在内的医疗物资，并将其出售……

sentences.en: At the same time, though, we also see another kind of response.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我们也看到了另一种反应。

sentences.en: People looking for ways to help each other.
sentences.zh: 人们在寻找互相帮助的方法。

sentences.en: Erica Strauss-Chavaria is a high school Spanish teacher in Columbia, Maryland.
sentences.zh: 埃里卡·施特劳斯-查瓦里亚是马里兰州哥伦比亚市的一名高中西班牙语老师。

sentences.en: In March, she launched a grassroots network called Columbia Community Care
sentences.zh: 三月份，她发起了一个名为“哥伦比亚社区关怀”的草根网络，

sentences.en: to provide food and other essential products to people in need.
sentences.zh: 旨在为有需要的人提供食物和其他必需品。

sentences.en: We typically serve around 100 people per site per day.
sentences.zh: 我们通常每天在每个站点服务约100人。

sentences.en: We also have our home grocery delivery service,
sentences.zh: 我们还有家庭杂货配送服务，

sentences.en: and we have served, at this point, over 1,500 families in that capacity.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经通过这种方式服务了超过1500个家庭。

sentences.en: There are many others like Erica.
sentences.zh: 像埃里卡这样的人还有很多。

sentences.en: Someone in Texas tipped more than $9,000 on a dinner bill in order to help restaurant staff.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州有人在餐费账单上额外支付了超过9000美元的小费，以帮助餐厅员工。

sentences.en: One message was written on the receipt only.
sentences.zh: 收据上只写了一条信息。

sentences.en: It says, hold to pay your guys over the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：坚持住，在接下来的几周里付给你们的伙计们。
这位给小费的人是常客……

sentences.en: And a retired farmer in Kansas sent an N95 mask to New York Governor Andrew Cuomo.
sentences.zh: 还有一位堪萨斯州的退休农民给纽约州州长安德鲁·科莫寄去了一个N95口罩。

sentences.en: You send one mask, one mask to New York to help a nurse or a doctor.
sentences.zh: 你寄出一个口罩，寄出一个口罩到纽约去帮助护士或医生。

sentences.en: I mean, how selfless is that?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这难道不无私吗？

sentences.en: Think about this man who donated a mask and the one who hoarded masks.
sentences.zh: 想想这个捐赠口罩的人，再想想那个囤积口罩的人。

sentences.en: If you were a legislator, you might want to pass a law that takes aim at the profiteer.
sentences.zh: 如果你是立法者，你可能会想通过一项针对牟取暴利者的法律。

sentences.en: Most public and economic policy focuses on lawbreakers and wrongdoers.
sentences.zh: 大多数公共和经济政策都关注违法者和作恶者。

sentences.en: But what would happen if we were to care less about the man who hoards masks
sentences.zh: 但如果我们少关注那些囤积口罩的人，

sentences.en: and put the man who donated his mask at the center of our thinking?
sentences.zh: 而把捐赠口罩的人放在我们思考的中心，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: do the measures we put in place to curtail the selfish
sentences.zh: 我们为遏制自私行为而采取的措施，

sentences.en: have perverse consequences on the rest of us?
sentences.zh: 是否会对我们其他人产生反作用？

sentences.en: Both in times of crisis and in normal times,
sentences.zh: 无论是在危机时期还是在正常时期，

sentences.en: public policy is focused on keeping bad people from doing bad things.
sentences.zh: 公共政策的重点都是防止坏人做坏事。

sentences.en: Behavioral economist Sam Bowles thinks this is a mistake.
sentences.zh: 行为经济学家萨姆·鲍尔斯认为这是一个错误。

sentences.en: He worries that such policies not only underestimate the capacity of most people to do the right thing,
sentences.zh: 他担心这些政策不仅低估了大多数人做正确事情的能力，

sentences.en: but can inadvertently hurt our ability to do right by others.
sentences.zh: 而且可能会无意中损害我们为他人做正确之事的意愿。

sentences.en: He explores this idea in his book, The Moral Economy.
sentences.zh: 他在他的书《道德经济》中探讨了这个观点。

sentences.en: Sam Bowles, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·鲍尔斯，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: A central assumption in economics, Sam,
sentences.zh: 萨姆，经济学的一个核心假设是，

sentences.en: is that humans are motivated by rational self-intereSt.
sentences.zh: 人类是由理性的自身利益所驱动的。

sentences.en: The price of something goes up, I buy less of it.
sentences.zh: 某样东西价格上涨，我就少买点。

sentences.en: The price of something goes down, I buy more of it.
sentences.zh: 某样东西价格下跌，我就多买点。
像许多行为经济学家一样，

sentences.en: you say this assumption turns our species of Homo sapiens into a new one,
sentences.zh: 你说这个假设把我们智人这个物种变成了一个新的物种，

sentences.en: What are the traits of this other species?
sentences.zh: 这个新物种有什么特征？

sentences.en: Well, this being, Homo economicus or economic man,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个生物，即“经济人”或经济人，

sentences.en: cares only about himself or herself,
and therefore evaluates actions that may be taken
sentences.zh: 因此评估可能采取的行动时，

sentences.en: simply in terms of what's in it for me.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是从“这对我有什么好处”的角度出发。

sentences.en: That's the basic idea of Homo economicus.
sentences.zh: 这就是“经济人”的基本理念。
所以这是关于自身利益的部分。

sentences.en: which is that not only are we self-interested,
sentences.zh: 那就是我们不仅追求自身利益，

sentences.en: we're pretty good at doing it.
sentences.zh: 而且我们非常擅长这样做。

sentences.en: So we're very able to think about the consequences of our actions.
sentences.zh: 所以我们非常有能力思考我们行为的后果。

sentences.en: And that's the part that usually is associated with the word rational.
sentences.zh: 这就是通常与“理性”一词相关联的部分。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how this idea has percolated beyond the boundaries of just economics,
sentences.zh: 我想知道这个想法是如何渗透到经济学之外的领域的，

sentences.en: because I feel like when I watch television or read books,
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得当我看电视或读书时，

sentences.en: this idea that people are out for themselves,
sentences.zh: 这种“人们只为自己着想”的想法，

sentences.en: I'm thinking about the TV show Succession, for example.
sentences.zh: 比如，我想到电视剧《继承之战》。

sentences.en: I'm concerned you might be soft.
sentences.zh: 我担心你可能太软弱了。

sentences.en: The only way he'll respect you is if you try to destroy him.
sentences.zh: 他尊重你的唯一方法就是你试图摧毁他。

sentences.en: I'm not saying I would make a better CEO.
sentences.zh: 我不是说我会成为一个更好的CEO。

sentences.en: It's not unsaid when you say it.
sentences.zh: 当你把它说出来时，它就不是没说出来的了。

sentences.en: You know, all the members of this family are fighting tooth and nail
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个家庭的所有成员都在拼命争斗，

sentences.en: to take over their father's media company.
sentences.zh: 想要接管他们父亲的媒体公司。

sentences.en: Everyone is out for only one thing, which is personal gain.
sentences.zh: 每个人都只追求一件事，那就是个人利益。

sentences.en: So this idea that rational behavior is selfish behavior
sentences.zh: 所以，这种“理性行为就是自私行为”的想法，

sentences.en: is more than just economics right now.
sentences.zh: 现在不仅仅是经济学了。

sentences.en: It's in movies, not just in textbooks.
sentences.zh: 它存在于电影中，而不仅仅是在教科书中。
我认为你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: There is the economics of the classroom,
the seminar room, and the think tank.
sentences.zh: 研讨室和智库里的经济学。

sentences.en: And that's presented in a certain way,
usually fairly mathematically and so on.
But then there's what I call the economics vernacular.
sentences.zh: 但还有我所说的“经济学白话”。

sentences.en: That's the way ordinary people express economic truths.
sentences.zh: 那是普通人表达经济真理的方式。

sentences.en: And what you'll hear a lot is,
you get what you pay for.
Or you'll hear former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher
sentences.zh: 或者你会听到前英国首相玛格丽特·撒切尔

sentences.en: saying, there's no such thing as society.
sentences.zh: 说，根本没有社会这回事。

sentences.en: All we are is an individual.
And these then become common sayings.
So I want to talk about one last domain before we switch to some of the problems with the model
sentences.zh: 所以我想在转向你和其他人发现的该模型的一些问题之前，谈谈最后一个领域。

sentences.en: that you and others have identified.
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅存在于流行文化中。

sentences.en: It's not just in pop culture.
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅存在于商业和贸易中。

sentences.en: It's not just in business and in commerce.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为人类从根本上是由自身利益驱动的，

sentences.en: If you think that human beings are fundamentally motivated by self-interest,
sentences.zh: 由狭隘的自身利益，由自私驱动的，
你作为政府的工作就是试图限制人们的行为，

sentences.en: your job as the government is to try and restrict how people behave,
sentences.zh: 你想给人们的自私踩刹车。

sentences.en: that you want to sort of put brakes on people's selfishness.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你想把政府看作是“坏警察”，

sentences.en: In other words, you want to think of government as the bad cop,
sentences.zh: 一股打击所有无赖和恶棍的力量，

sentences.en: a force that cracks down on all the knaves and villains out there,
sentences.zh: 因为外面的人都是这样。

sentences.en: because that's all the people who are out there.

sentences.zh: 嗯，这正是某些政府所做的。

sentences.en: Well, that's exactly what some governments have done.
sentences.zh: 我认为一件非常值得注意的事情是，在决策圈里，

sentences.en: And I think one of the really remarkable things is that in policymaking circles,
sentences.zh: 如果你说“听着，每个人都是自私的”，你会被认为是非常聪明和现实的。

sentences.en: you're regarded as highly intelligent and realistic if you say,
sentences.zh: 我们必须把公民、纳税人、员工等等，
当作完全自私的人来对待，

sentences.en: We have to treat the citizen, the taxpayer, the employee, and so on,
sentences.zh: 因为否则我们可能会显得很傻，或者可能会被占便宜等等。

sentences.en: as if he or she was entirely selfish,
sentences.zh: 所以那些并不真正相信这一点的人认为你应该继续使用这个假设，

sentences.en: because otherwise maybe we're a chump or maybe we'll be taken advantage of and so on.
sentences.zh: 即“经济人”，因为这很审慎。

sentences.en: And so people who don't really believe it think that you should go on with this assumption
sentences.zh: 可能确实有些人就是那样。

sentences.en: of homo economicus because it's prudent.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，我们最好小心点。

sentences.en: There might be some people who are really like that.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们将设计政策等等，就好像每个人都是那样。

sentences.en: And if so, we'd better watch out.
sentences.zh: 大卫·休谟，18世纪的哲学家、经济学家，就在亚当·斯密之前，

sentences.en: And therefore, we're going to design policies and so on as if everyone was that way.
sentences.zh: 他说在设计政府时，你应该假设每个人都是无赖。

sentences.en: David Hume, a philosopher, economist of the 18th century, just before Adam Smith,
sentences.zh: 他用了那个古老的词“无赖”，心里想的除了追求自己的利益别无他物。

sentences.en: he said that in designing a government, you should assume that everyone is a knave.
sentences.zh: 所以考虑到标准经济模型“经济人”的盛行，

sentences.en: He used that ancient word, a knave, and has nothing in his mind but pursuing his own intereSt.
sentences.zh: 不仅在经济学中，而且在政治、流行文化和其他领域，

sentences.en: So given the predominance of the standard economic model, homo economicus,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这些模型很难解释为什么人们会做很多事情。

sentences.en: not just in economics but in politics and popular culture and other domains,
sentences.zh: 经常被引用的经典例子是，你在国外旅行，

sentences.en: it's interesting that the models have trouble explaining why people do lots of things.
sentences.zh: 你去了一家餐馆，坐下来，吃了一顿美餐，

sentences.en: And the classic example that's often given is that you're on a trip to a foreign country,
sentences.zh: 在用餐结束时，你必须决定是否给服务员小费。

sentences.en: you go to a restaurant, you sit down at the restaurant, you have a nice meal,
sentences.zh: 你永远不会再见到那个服务员了，因为你可能这辈子都不会再回到那家餐馆了。

sentences.en: and at the end of the meal, you have to decide whether to tip the waiter.
sentences.zh: 理性的、追求自身利益的做法是省下你的钱。

sentences.en: And you're never going to see the waiter again because you're probably not going to go back
sentences.zh: 但我们中的许多人并没有这样做。

sentences.en: to that restaurant ever again in your life.
sentences.zh: 我们还是决定给那个服务员小费。

sentences.en: The rational, self-interested thing to do is to save some of your money.
sentences.zh: 也许其中一部分是习惯，或者也许是内疚。
也许这只是让你感觉良好。

sentences.en: We decide to tip that waiter anyway.
sentences.zh: 无论原因是什么，所有这些混乱的人性事物，

sentences.en: And maybe some of it is habit or maybe it's guilt.
sentences.zh: 似乎都存在于“经济人”模型之外。

sentences.en: Maybe it just makes you feel good.
Whatever the reason, there's all this messy human stuff
that seems to live outside the model of homo economicus.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，当你试图真正预测行为时，你就会出错。
该模型一直系统性地出错，例如，
为什么你会给那些你永远不会再见到的人小费？

sentences.en: And because of that, when you try to actually predict behavior, you get it wrong.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况一次又一次地发生。

sentences.en: The model has been systematically wrong, for example,
sentences.zh: 该模型一直系统性地出错，例如，

sentences.en: in why do you tip people who you're never going to see again?
sentences.zh: 为什么你会给那些你永远不会再见到的人小费？

sentences.en: And it happens over and over again.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况一次又一次地发生。

sentences.en: People pay taxes far more than they should if all they cared about was enforcement.
sentences.zh: 如果人们只关心执法力度，那么他们缴纳的税款将远超实际水平。

sentences.en: That is, people have calculated whether or not the expected gain to trying to cheat is actually worth it.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，人们已经计算过，试图逃税的预期收益是否真的值得冒险。

sentences.en: But people cheat remarkably little on their taxes.
sentences.zh: 但人们在纳税时，作弊的情况却少得惊人。
或者考虑一下这个例子。

sentences.en: People often say, political scientists do, and we often think that,
sentences.zh: 人们常说，政治学家也常说，我们通常认为，

sentences.en: well, when you go to the ballot box, you vote your pocketbook or your wallet.
sentences.zh: 当你走进投票站时，你是为了自己的钱袋子或钱包而投票。

sentences.en: They never bother to ask, well, if that's the case, why did you go to the ballot box in the first place?
sentences.zh: 但他们从不费心去问，如果真是这样，你当初为什么要走进投票站呢？
为什么要费那个劲去投票？

sentences.en: It took you a little bit of time to get down to the polling place.
sentences.zh: 你花了一些时间才赶到投票点。

sentences.en: And you're sure that your vote won't settle the election.
sentences.zh: 而且你很清楚，你的那一票并不能决定选举结果。

sentences.en: So if you vote selfishly, why vote at all?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是出于自私才去投票，那为什么还要去呢？

sentences.en: Now, these are pretty basic contradictions in a theory.
sentences.zh: 这些都是理论中非常基本的矛盾。

sentences.en: And it's surprising it survived as long as it did.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，这种理论竟然存在了这么久。

sentences.en: Because it does such a bad job in explaining what people do.
sentences.zh: 因为它在解释人们的行为方面做得太差了。

sentences.en: And it also contradicts very much our own introspection, not only about ourselves,
sentences.zh: 而且它也极大地违背了我们自身的内省，不仅是对我们自己，

sentences.en: but we see others doing acts of great generosity, often self-sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 我们还看到别人做出慷慨甚至自我牺牲的行为。

sentences.en: And it's surprising to me that economists didn't wonder sooner than now.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，经济学家们竟然没有早点对此产生怀疑。

sentences.en: I wonder if this model is really OK, because it's not doing so well in predicting a lot of behaviors which are not controversial.
sentences.zh: 我在想这个模型是否真的没问题，因为它在预测许多非争议性行为时表现并不好。
每个人都知道这些行为是存在的。

sentences.en: These acts of generosity and self-sacrifice can be seen in many workplaces.
sentences.zh: 这些慷慨和自我牺牲的行为在许多工作场所都能见到。

sentences.en: Both teach fourth grade and both cover the syllabus.
sentences.zh: 他们都教四年级，也都完成了教学大纲。

sentences.en: As far as the principal and the parents are concerned, both teachers have fulfilled their contracts.
sentences.zh: 在校长和家长看来，两位老师都履行了合同。

sentences.en: But one of the teachers is really inspiring.
sentences.zh: 但其中一位老师真的很鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: She leaves kids with the feeling they want to do more.
sentences.zh: 她让孩子们产生了一种想要做得更好的渴望。

sentences.en: That kind of enthusiasm and love cannot be written into a contract.
sentences.zh: 那种热情和爱是无法写进合同里的。

sentences.en: Or think about what's happening with COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 或者想想新冠疫情期间发生的事情。

sentences.en: Millions of people are working from home, often in jobs where the quality of their work may be difficult to assess in the short term.
sentences.zh: 数百万人居家办公，他们的工作质量在短期内往往难以评估。

sentences.en: What prompts them to go above and beyond?
sentences.zh: 是什么促使他们精益求精、超越自我呢？
如今有太多的工作是这样了。

sentences.en: It's not that they're done remotely.
sentences.zh: 并不是因为它们是远程完成的。

sentences.en: It's that you can't really tell if the person's doing a good job or not until much later.
sentences.zh: 而是因为直到很久以后，你才能真正判断一个人是否做得好。

sentences.en: A lot of those jobs are, for example, in scientific research and teaching and so on, jobs with which I'm familiar personally.
sentences.zh: 很多这样的工作，例如科学研究和教学等，都是我个人熟悉的工作。

sentences.en: But a lot of them are also not well-paid jobs.
sentences.zh: 但其中许多工作薪水并不高。

sentences.en: I mean, think about being a waiter or a waitress in a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我是说，想想餐厅里的服务员。

sentences.en: How does the manager know if the person's doing a good job?
sentences.zh: 经理怎么知道那个人是否做得好？

sentences.en: They don't know the nuance of how the person spoke to the other one.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道那个人与客人交谈时的细微差别。

sentences.en: Or think about caring for the elderly or caring for kids.
sentences.zh: 或者想想照顾老人或照顾孩子的工作。

sentences.en: Those are very difficult jobs, and they're very difficult to do well.
sentences.zh: 那些是非常困难的工作，而且很难做好。

sentences.en: But most of all, they're virtually impossible for a supervisor to know is the job being well done.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，主管几乎不可能知道工作是否做得好。

sentences.en: In those jobs, we're going to have to rely on people wanting to do a good job.
sentences.zh: 在这些工作中，我们必须依赖人们想要做好工作的意愿。

sentences.en: We're going to talk a lot about how values and norms and beliefs shape our economic, professional, and civic lives.
sentences.zh: 我们将深入探讨价值观、规范和信仰如何塑造我们的经济、职业和公民生活。

sentences.en: But I do want to lay down a caveat.
It's one thing to say that feelings and values and preferences matter.
sentences.zh: 说情感、价值观和偏好很重要是一回事。

sentences.en: It's another thing to imagine that feelings and values can explain everything.
sentences.zh: 认为情感和价值观能解释一切则是另一回事。

sentences.en: So I am regularly motivated by self-intereSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常受到自身利益的驱动。

sentences.en: There are two gas stations across the street from one another in my neighborhood,
sentences.zh: 在我家附近，街对面有两家加油站，

sentences.en: and one is consistently more expensive than the other.
sentences.zh: 其中一家总是比另一家贵。

sentences.en: When I first moved to the neighborhood, Sam, I stopped by the more expensive station.
sentences.zh: 我刚搬到附近时，Sam，我去了那家贵的加油站。

sentences.en: But once I noticed the price difference, I never went back.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我注意到价格差异，我就再也没去过。

sentences.en: So you can take the model of homo economicus too far,
sentences.zh: 所以你可以把“经济人”模型推得太远，

sentences.en: but presumably you can also take its mirror image too far as well, right?
sentences.zh: 但想必你也可以把它的镜像推得太远，对吧？

sentences.en: And the task that has to be done is to find ways of organizing our economy and our public policy,
sentences.zh: 我们需要完成的任务是找到组织经济和公共政策的方法，

sentences.en: not so that we rely solely on self-interest,
sentences.zh: 不是让我们仅仅依赖自身利益，

sentences.en: and surely not so that we rely solely on our regard for others,
sentences.zh: 当然也不是让我们仅仅依赖对他人的关怀，

sentences.en: but that we can rely on both,
sentences.zh: 而是我们可以两者兼顾，

sentences.en: and we should design policies so that those two aspects of our human being
sentences.zh: 我们应该设计政策，使我们人类的这两个方面

sentences.en: are working together in a synergistic or complementary way.
sentences.zh: 以协同或互补的方式共同发挥作用。

sentences.en: That is what Adam Smith was talking about.
sentences.zh: 这就是亚当·斯密所谈论的内容。

sentences.en: His two great books were The Wealth of Nations, as is well known,
sentences.zh: 众所周知，他的两部伟大著作是《国富论》，

sentences.en: but also The Theory of Moral Sentiments.
But what economists took over from Smith was the affluence through competition part,
sentences.zh: 但经济学家从斯密那里继承的只是通过竞争实现富裕的部分，

sentences.en: and they set aside the idea that there's a culture which is required in order for that system to work.
sentences.zh: 却抛弃了该系统运作所需的文化理念。

sentences.en: He thought that we should combine the material interests with the moral sentiments,
sentences.zh: 他认为我们应该将物质利益与道德情操结合起来，

sentences.en: and he thought that there was a way of doing that.
sentences.zh: 并且他认为有一种方法可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: So I think, yes, the idea that you can replace the self-interested system of competition on markets for profits and so on
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，是的，那种认为你可以用基于利润竞争的自利系统来取代市场，

sentences.en: with an entirely different system based on, essentially, regard for others,
sentences.zh: 换成一个完全基于对他人的关怀的系统，
我是说，这显然是错误的。

sentences.en: I mean, the whole world cannot be organized as if we're just on a little camping trip.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，整个世界不可能像我们都在进行一次小露营旅行那样来组织。

sentences.en: When we come back, the consequences of imagining a world
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，想象一个充满搭便车者、违规者和自私者的世界，

sentences.en: that is filled only with freeloaders, delinquents, and selfishness.

sentences.zh: 你正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Sam Bowles is a behavioral economist at the Santa Fe Institute.
sentences.zh: Sam Bowles 是圣达菲研究所的行为经济学家。

sentences.en: He argues that economic models often reduce people to one dimension,
sentences.zh: 他认为经济模型往往将人简化为一个维度，
即他们狭隘的自身利益。

sentences.en: These models fail to acknowledge the many motivators that drive human behavior.
sentences.zh: 这些模型未能承认驱动人类行为的多种动机。

sentences.en: Such thinking has become a staple not just in boardrooms and in commerce, but in government.
sentences.zh: 这种思维不仅在董事会和商业领域，而且在政府中也已成为主流。

sentences.en: If you think the world is filled with selfish knaves,
sentences.zh: 如果你认为世界充满了自私的无赖，

sentences.en: you think you need a world of rules to constrain those knaves.
sentences.zh: 你就会认为你需要一套规则来约束这些无赖。

sentences.en: Sam, about two decades ago, the Boston Fire Department was having a problem.
sentences.zh: Sam，大约二十年前，波士顿消防局遇到了一个问题。

sentences.en: Administrators were worried that workers were abusing the sick leave policy,
sentences.zh: 管理人员担心员工滥用病假政策，

sentences.en: and at that time, workers could take an unlimited amount of sick time.
sentences.zh: 当时，员工可以享受无限期的病假。
于是，管理人员修改了政策。

sentences.en: Well, they noticed that the call-ins for sick days happened to come on Fridays and Mondays,
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们注意到请病假的人往往集中在周五和周一，

sentences.en: and that didn't seem kind of reasonable to them.
sentences.zh: 这在他们看来似乎不太合理。

sentences.en: So, they told the firemen that they'd have a limited number of sick days,
sentences.zh: 所以，他们告诉消防员，他们只能享受有限的病假天数，

sentences.en: and if they called in more often than that, their pay would be docked.
sentences.zh: 如果请假次数超过这个限度，工资就会被扣除。

sentences.en: And the firemen felt that they were being distrusted.
sentences.zh: 消防员们感到自己受到了不信任。

sentences.en: Most of them surely were not actually calling in sick when they were not.
sentences.zh: 他们中大多数人肯定不是在没病的时候装病请假。

sentences.en: They were quite angry at the fire commissioner.
sentences.zh: 他们对消防局长非常愤怒。

sentences.en: This happened just before Christmas, and what happened on Christmas Day was masses of them called in.
sentences.zh: 这件事发生在圣诞节前夕，结果圣诞节当天，大批消防员请了病假。

sentences.en: The same thing happened on New Year's Day.
sentences.zh: 元旦那天也发生了同样的情况。

sentences.en: In the meantime, the ones who were calling in sick in large numbers on Christmas and New Year's
sentences.zh: 与此同时，那些在圣诞节和元旦大量请病假的人，

sentences.en: had their bonuses cancelled, and the conflict went on for over a year.
sentences.zh: 他们的奖金被取消了，冲突持续了一年多。

sentences.en: The amount of sick call-ins doubled in the year following this
sentences.zh: 在政策实施后的那一年里，病假申请数量翻了一番，

sentences.en: until the commissioner finally realized that he'd made a big mistake, and he cancelled the policy.
sentences.zh: 直到局长最终意识到他犯了一个大错，并取消了该政策。

sentences.en: I understand there were almost 7,000 more sick days taken than were taken in the previous year
sentences.zh: 我了解到，在实施这些严厉政策后的那一年里，

sentences.en: following the implementation of these harsh policies.
sentences.zh: 请病假的天数比前一年增加了近 7000 天。
从大约 6 天增加到了 13 天以上。

sentences.en: And the interviews with the firemen were really poignant.
sentences.zh: 对消防员的采访真的令人心酸。

sentences.en: I mean, they said, look, you know, we come to work when we're sick.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们说，看，你知道，我们生病时也会来上班。

sentences.en: We risk injury and so on.
sentences.zh: 我们冒着受伤的风险等等。

sentences.en: And this person is saying that essentially we are selfishly calling in when we're not sick.
sentences.zh: 而这个人却说，我们本质上是在没病的时候自私地请假。

sentences.en: Well, surely some of them were.
It looks like some of them were.
sentences.zh: 看起来确实有些人是这样。

sentences.en: But the problem was that applying that policy across the board backfired.
sentences.zh: 但问题在于，全面推行该政策适得其反。
那么，为什么会适得其反呢？

sentences.en: Well, presumably for the ones who really were being self-interested in calling in sick when they weren't,
sentences.zh: 嗯，大概对于那些确实在没病时自私请假的人来说，

sentences.en: a policy like that would be necessary.
sentences.zh: 这样的政策是有必要的。

sentences.en: Well, it just had a terrible effect on their morale and their sense of obligation to the fire commissioner
sentences.zh: 嗯，这对他们的士气以及他们对消防局长和消防局的责任感产生了可怕的影响。
所以这是我们现在在社会中面临的一个问题，即在考虑试图激励人们

sentences.en: So that's a problem that we now face in society, which is in thinking about trying to motivate people
sentences.zh: 去做某事时，激励措施往往被建议作为一种手段。

sentences.en: to do things, incentives are often suggested as a way of doing this.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果你做了这件事，无论是什么，你都会得到更多的报酬。

sentences.en: That is, if you do this, whatever it is, you get paid more.
sentences.zh: 我们听说过鼓励孩子读书、减肥的激励措施，甚至还有鼓励投票的激励措施。

sentences.en: And we hear about incentives for kids reading books and for losing weight, even incentives for voting.
sentences.zh: 最近在德国，有人提议我们应该采取激励措施，即金钱激励，

sentences.en: And recently in Germany, somebody has proposed we should have incentives, monetary incentives,
sentences.zh: 与新冠疫情期间的社交距离等有关。

sentences.en: having to do with social distancing because of the COVID-19 pandemic and so on.
sentences.zh: 所以几乎没有什么事情是没有被当作“我们可以设计一些激励措施来解决这个问题”的例子的。

sentences.en: So there's almost nothing that hasn't been an example of, well, we can actually design some incentives to fix this.
sentences.zh: 现在，这种观点在政策制定和法学领域占据了主导地位。

sentences.en: Now, that's a view that has dominated policymaking and also jurisprudence.
sentences.zh: 整个法律、经济学和公共政策领域都致力于这样一个理念：我们可以设计一种激励措施来诱导正确的行为。

sentences.en: And the whole area of law and economics and public policy is committed to the idea that we can design an incentive to induce the right behavior.
sentences.zh: 我也对波士顿消防局实施的政策感到震惊，

sentences.en: I'm also struck by the fact that the policies implemented by the fire department in Boston
sentences.zh: 因为它改变了人们思考“请病假意味着什么”的框架。

sentences.en: changed the frame around which people were thinking about what it meant to take a sick day.
sentences.zh: 所以当病假时间无限时，你的想法是：好吧，如果我生病或受伤了，我会请病假。

sentences.en: So when the sick time was unlimited, your thinking was, OK, I would take sick time if I was sick or if I was injured.
And I would take as much time as I needed.
sentences.zh: 当我被告知现在只能请 15 天，如果超过这个天数，我们就会惩罚你时。

sentences.en: When I'm told you can now have only 15 days and if you go beyond that, we're going to punish you.
sentences.zh: 现在我开始想，好吧，如果我没真的生病，但这一年快过完了，我最好还是把那 15 天用掉。

sentences.en: Now I start to think, OK, I better use those 15 days if I'm not really sick, but the year is nearly up.
I'm going to lose that time.

sentences.zh: 当然是无意的，但这个框架改变了我对“生病意味着什么”和“请病假意味着什么”的思考方式。

sentences.en: Unintended, of course, but the frame changes the way I'm starting to think about what it means to be sick and what it means to take sick time.
sentences.zh: 这正是发生的事情，或者至少是我能给出的最好解释。

sentences.en: That's exactly what happened, or at least that's the best explanation I could have of it.
sentences.zh: 但这里还有另一个例子，我认为你将其称为框架问题是非常正确的。

sentences.en: But here's another in which I think the way you put it as a framing problem is exactly right.
sentences.zh: 在以色列海法，有一堆日托中心，大约有十几家。

sentences.en: In Haifa, Israel, there were a bunch of daycare centers, about a dozen of them.
sentences.zh: 孩子们早上来，父母晚上接他们。

sentences.en: And the kids came in the morning and the parents picked them up in the evening.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，有些父母来晚了。

sentences.en: And as is the case, some parents came late.
sentences.zh: 于是他们决定对迟到的父母处以罚款。

sentences.en: And they decided that they were going to impose a fine on the parents coming late.
sentences.zh: 嗯，幸运的是，对于经济科学来说，几位行为经济学家了解到了这一点。

sentences.en: Well, happily for economic science, a couple of behavioral economists knew about it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，不，等等，等等。

sentences.en: And so they said, no, wait, wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 让我们只在其中一半的日托中心实行，另一半不实行，这样我们就能做一个很好的实验。

sentences.en: Let's just do it on half of the daycare centers and not do it on the other half so we have a nice experiment.
sentences.zh: 果然，有一天父母们来送孩子时，看到了一则通知。

sentences.en: So sure enough, one day the parents came, dropped off their kids, and there was a notice.
sentences.zh: （注：此条原文缺失，根据上下文逻辑补充）

sentences.en: It said, starting tomorrow, anyone who's picking up their kid more than 10 minutes late will be fined 10 Israeli shekels.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，从明天开始，任何接孩子迟到超过10分钟的人，将被罚款10以色列新谢克尔。

sentences.en: And then they recorded, they had been recording what was happening in the week before,
sentences.zh: 然后他们进行了记录，他们一直在记录之前一周发生的情况，

sentences.en: and then they recorded how many people came late in the daycare centers,
sentences.zh: 接着他们记录了有多少人去托儿所接孩子迟到了，

sentences.en: which had the fine and those where there was no fine.
sentences.zh: 包括那些有罚款的托儿所和没有罚款的托儿所。

sentences.en: In the places where there was no fine, nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 在没有罚款的地方，什么也没发生。

sentences.en: It continued, there was actually a small number.
sentences.zh: 情况照旧，迟到的人数其实很少。

sentences.en: In the ones in which the fine was imposed on the parents coming late, the amount of lateness doubled.
sentences.zh: 而在那些对迟到的家长处以罚款的托儿所里，迟到现象翻了一番。

sentences.en: Now, how can you possibly explain that?
The fine was supposed to get them to come on time to pick up their kids.
sentences.zh: 罚款本意是让他们准时来接孩子。

sentences.en: Now, if you think about it, and there are lots of possible interpretations of what happened,
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你仔细想想，关于发生的事情有很多种可能的解读，

sentences.en: but what you just said, Shankar, about framing seems to be the most likely explanation,
sentences.zh: 但你刚才提到的关于“框架效应”的说法，似乎是最可能的解释，

sentences.en: which is the parents framed coming late or coming early to pick up their kids.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，家长们把“迟到”或“早到”接孩子这件事重新定义了。
这本质上是一个道德问题。

sentences.en: I mean, perhaps not high morals, but you ought to pick up your kid on time
sentences.zh: 我是说，也许谈不上什么崇高的道德，但你理应准时接孩子，

sentences.en: because your kid might be anxious because the teachers maybe want to go home
sentences.zh: 因为孩子可能会感到焦虑，或者老师们可能想早点回家

sentences.en: and be with their kids or there's something like that.
sentences.zh: 去陪自己的孩子，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Okay, sometimes there's extra traffic and you're late.
sentences.zh: 好吧，有时是因为交通拥堵导致你迟到了。

sentences.en: But it was a moral question.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是个道德问题。

sentences.en: As soon as you put a price on it, then it's just like a commodity.
sentences.zh: 一旦你给它标上价格，它就变成了一种商品。

sentences.en: It's a shirt or a beer.
sentences.zh: 就像一件衬衫或一瓶啤酒。

sentences.en: You want to get some lateness?
Here's where you can get it.
sentences.zh: 这里就是你可以买到迟到的地方。
只需要10以色列新谢克尔。

sentences.en: So I think they turned this thing from an ethical problem
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们把这件事从一个道德问题

sentences.en: into more or less a self-interest problem.
sentences.zh: 变成了或多或少的利益问题。

sentences.en: And apparently 10 Israeli shekels wasn't a big enough fine
sentences.zh: 显然，10以色列新谢克尔的罚款金额并不够大，

sentences.en: to really cause them to do anything differently.
sentences.zh: 不足以真正促使他们做出任何改变。

sentences.en: Researchers have found that different parts of the brain
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现，大脑的不同部位

sentences.en: might be involved in weighing those probleMs.
sentences.zh: 可能参与了对这些问题的权衡。

sentences.en: Ethical judgments are not processed the same way as cost-benefit equations.
sentences.zh: 道德判断的处理方式与成本效益计算并不相同。

sentences.en: Our brain has obviously regions that do certain things.
sentences.zh: 我们的大脑显然有负责特定功能的区域。

sentences.en: Processing benefits and costs is something which we're pretty good at.
sentences.zh: 处理收益和成本是我们非常擅长的事情。

sentences.en: And that's done in one part of the brain.
sentences.zh: 这由大脑的某一部分来完成。

sentences.en: And there are other things having to do with feelings, obligations, and so on.
sentences.zh: 而其他部分则与情感、义务等有关。

sentences.en: But the fact that just putting some money on the table
sentences.zh: 但仅仅是把钱摆在桌面上这一事实，

sentences.en: will relocate the activity of the brain to the prefrontal cortex,
sentences.zh: 就会将大脑的活动转移到前额叶皮层，

sentences.en: which is where you process benefits and costs and so on,
sentences.zh: 也就是你处理收益和成本等问题的地方，
这确实是一个惊人的发现。

sentences.en: So it suggests that, you know, that's what we're like.
sentences.zh: 所以这表明，你知道，我们就是这样的人。

sentences.en: And we're probably not going to change, so we'd better accommodate that.
sentences.zh: 而且我们可能不会改变，所以我们最好适应这一点。

sentences.en: One of the sad things you note about the Haifa daycare story
sentences.zh: 关于海法托儿所的故事，你指出的一个令人悲哀的事情是，

sentences.en: is what happened when the daycare reversed the policy around the fine.
sentences.zh: 当托儿所取消罚款政策时发生了什么。

sentences.en: So obviously it backfired, and then administrators reversed the policy
sentences.zh: 显然，罚款适得其反，于是管理人员撤销了政策，

sentences.en: and said, OK, we're taking away the fines.

sentences.zh: 那是一件令人惊奇的事情。

sentences.en: When they took away the fine,
the lateness persisted in the schools, in the daycare centers,
sentences.zh: 迟到现象在那些曾经有罚款的学校和托儿所里依然存在，

sentences.en: The control schools, the control centers had no effect.
sentences.zh: 而对照组的学校和中心则没有受到影响。

sentences.en: But now, just to get this, I have to say it again because it's so unusual.
sentences.zh: 但为了弄明白这一点，我必须再说一遍，因为它太不寻常了。

sentences.en: When they imposed the fine on being late, the parents came later.
sentences.zh: 当他们对迟到进行罚款时，家长们反而来得更晚了。

sentences.en: And when they took away the fine, they continued coming later.
sentences.zh: 而当他们取消罚款时，家长们依然来得很晚。

sentences.en: Well, I think the story about framing is exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为关于“框架效应”的解释正是原因所在。

sentences.en: It used to be an ethical question.
sentences.zh: 它曾经是一个道德问题。
